failureRootCause.mechanism: Automatic canonical compaction omitted the host current-user binding. With assistant/tool tail the original user was ordinary conversation; final planning with the generated handoff could evict it under the conversation partition ceiling. The provider guard correctly refused the next request.

implementation.bindingCapture: Capture exact original current-user snapshot, original object identity, initial matching multiplicity and only host-owned resume-merge source bindings. Ordinary message mapping fields confer no authority.
implementation.projection: Resolve against live identity before canonical normalization; carry verified live source index through runtime/host-message filtering into canonical indexes. Both JSONL and live item projections use identical protected task-state bindings and retain full authority digest comparison.
implementation.commitGuard: Before append, recheck the actual caller array and the bound canonical itemId/digest. Exact same-text historical users in a summary are admitted only up to their verified dropped parent snapshot multiplicity. New task copies without that source capacity are rejected; the current original item can never be replaced by a generated summary.
implementation.restoration: Restore original bound object references from retained canonical source items. Update the known historical multiplicity in a private WeakMap only after verified commit.

oldBoundaryFaultInjection.trajectory: Original user with metadata, 36 tool/assistant rounds, no appended final user, 32768-token declared window, same valid larger handoff in both arms.
oldBoundaryFaultInjection.oldArm: Test-only wrapper removes only requiredUserBindings at canonical compactor entry. Real canonical planner commits, then real provider task guard throws CC_AGENT_TASK_CONTEXT_LOST. Exactly one stubbed Responses fetch (summary); no next provider fetch.
oldBoundaryFaultInjection.fixedArm: Same history and handoff with binding: canonical compaction commits and request completes; exactly two stubbed Responses fetches, original user retained.
